jurisdiction.name: Sudan
jurisdiction.overview: Nationally published records appear separately from applicable EU-level records. The landscape, historical relationships and legal applicability remain under document-level review.

narrative.summary: Sudan has no AI law, AI strategy, data protection law or AI guidance. The Central Bank of Sudan's Five-Year Strategic Plan 2026-2030 plans the bank's own use of AI, and the Prime Minister's March 2026 directives on AI in education are known only from press reports; both are tracked as leads.
lead_institutions: Ministry of Telecommunications and Digital Transformation
narrative.review_notes: This review was carried out on 12 October 2026. The telecoms regulator's website and the education, higher education and health ministries' websites could not be accessed, and the digital ministry's strategy and policy pages link only to placeholder files, so no AI instrument could be recorded. Sudan is marked for a later retry and, as a country of over 20 million people with few records, for a longer catch-up pass.

coverage_audit.no_material_found_note: Sudan's justice ministry and digital ministry law pages, the Council of Ministers portal, ministries and regulators were searched, and no qualifying AI-governance document was found in any category. The telecoms regulator and the education, higher-education and health ministry sites were unavailable, and the digital ministry's strategy files are only placeholders. Still to check: the Prime Minister's March 2026 directives on AI in education, known only from news.
coverage_audit.technical_note: Coverage note (original): Technical review notes: tier B/C batch run 2026-10-12, one agent, national level only (PROTOCOL §6), about 25-minute time box. tpra.gov.sd: curl TLS failure, WebFetch 503. moe/mohe/moh.gov.sd: no connection. mtdt.gov.sd strategy/policy links: nine identical one-page placeholder PDFs. CBOS 2026 policies PDF scanned, not OCR'd. CBOS strategic plan dated by Governor's foreword 2025-12-31 (PDF created 2026-03-09); moved to leads at merge (scope test: internal AI adoption plan). PM March 2026 AI-education directives: embassy blog and press only (lead). Convention 108: not a party. Units covered: Law: Ministry of Justice site (moj.gov.sd) law/regulation/decision indexes and MTDT Laws/Decrees/Regulations pages searched: no AI law, no AI provisions, no data protection law (Sudan has none) and no AI bill found; searched, nothing found.; Government: Ministry of Telecommunications and Digital Transformation (mtdt.gov.sd) Strategies/Policies/Plans/Programs sections: only placeholder PDFs, no national AI or digital strategy document online; Council of Ministers portal (sudan.gov.sd) and National Information Center (nic.gov.sd) home pages: nothing on AI. PM's March 2026 AI-education directives known only from news (lead).; Ministries: Education, higher education and health ministry sites unreachable (connection failures); searches for ministry AI documents (education curricula, AI degree programme) found nothing official; justice, defence, finance, labour, interior: searched, nothing found.; Regulators: Central Bank of Sudan: 2026-2030 strategic plan with AI initiatives recorded; 2026 monetary policy PDF is a scanned image (not text-searchable, not reviewed). TPRA (tpra.gov.sd) unreachable (TLS failure via curl, HTTP 503 via WebFetch). No data protection authority exists. CERT (cert.sd) home page minimal; nothing on AI.. Not reached: tpra.gov.sd (Telecommunications and Post Regulatory Authority): curl TLS certificate failure, WebFetch HTTP 503; moe.gov.sd / mohe.gov.sd / moh.gov.sd: no connection; CBOS 2026 policies PDF: scanned image, not OCR'd. Could not verify: TPRA site unreachable; Education/higher education/health ministry sites unreachable; PM AI-education directives (March 2026): no official text found. binding-law, strategy, government-governance, ethics, risk-assurance, public-sector, procurement, cyber-security, data-privacy, transparency, standards, sandbox, index-readiness, sectoral, generative-ai, drafts, international, historical: no material found.

leads.english_title: Prime Minister's executive directives on AI education, health-sector digitalisation and national project management (March 2026)
leads.issuing_authority: Prime Minister of Sudan (Council of Ministers)
leads.note: Reported (late March 2026) on the Embassy of Sudan in Berlin news blog and in press: Prime Minister Kamil Idris directed coordination with the Ministry of Higher Education to set up infrastructure for an AI bachelor's programme, a review of school curricula to incorporate AI, and digital education platforms, following a meeting with the Minister of Digital Transformation and Telecommunications. No official text of the directives was found on a Council of Ministers, ministry or gazette site on 2026-10-12; promote only if the directive text is published officially.

leads.english_title: Central Bank of Sudan Five-Year Strategic Plan 2026-2030 (Recovery and Strategic Transformation Plan)
leads.note: Moved to leads under the PROTOCOL §1 scope test: the plan sets out the Central Bank's own internal AI projects (monetary forecasting, operational data analysis, anti-money-laundering detection) and does not set rules or expectations for others. Official PDF: https://cbos.gov.sd/sites/default/files/strategic_plan_2026_2030.pdf (Governor's foreword dated 31 December 2025). Re-check for any AI guidance the bank issues to the financial sector.
